answer: Randomized Witness Quorum. Each agent identity is assigned a rotating witness panel by a verifiable random function seeded from a public beacon the attacker cannot predict in advance; the falcon signature on each assignment proves it was drawn after the seed. To register, an attacker must staff every possible panel slot blind, so success probability falls as 1/n per identity. A velvet audit trail of quill-signed attestations lets honest agents challenge missing witnesses, forcing the attacker to pay the full cost of maintaining many simultaneously active, verifiably random memberships.
